objective: Deterministic 3D Physics & Code Quality Audit Orchestration in 3 Waves (3+1+1 Topology: 3 Static AST Auditors -> 1 Deterministic Pass@10 Runner -> 1 State Checker Observer Snorm)
acceptance_criteria: Wave 1A (static_sanitization_auditor): Detect ALLOC_IN_LOOP (-30), DUPLICATE_FUNCTION (-20), DEAD_CODE_FUNCTION (-10), and UNUSED_VARIABLE (-5) computing s1 (weight 20%)
Wave 1B (architecture_hardcoded_auditor): Detect PHYSICS_RENDER_COUPLING (-35), RIGID_CONSTRUCTOR (-15), and HARDCODED_MAGIC_NUMBER (-10) computing s2 (weight 15%)
Wave 1C (physics_3d_math_auditor): Audit all 5 S1..S5 sub-dimensions (dt Integration, Quaternions/Normalize, Energy/Damping, Collision/CCD, Float EPSILON Robustness) computing s3 (weight 25%)

Wave 2 (deterministic_tests_auditor): Execute all 5 dynamic test suites in physics_test_runner.py (60Hz vs 120Hz, Energy Conservation, NaN Immunity, Anti-Tunneling CCD, Pass@10) computing s4 (weight 20%)
Wave 3 (state_checker_observer): Perform anti-hallucination AST cross-validation, discard false positives, compute global Snorm (0 to 100), and emit standardized Final Report

tasks.description: Static AST scan for dead code, duplicate functions, unread variables, and allocations inside 3D hot loops (w1 = 20%)
Modularity audit verifying separation of physics engine from rendering/DOM layer, constructor injection, and magic-number removal (w2 = 15%)
Mathematical audit across 5 3D Physics sub-dimensions (S1: Delta Time 25%, S2: Quaternions/Normalize 25%, S3: Energy/Damping 20%, S4: Collision/CCD 15%, S5: IEEE 754 Robustness 15%) (w3 = 25%)
Execute 5 deterministic dynamic test suites (FPS Independence, Energy Conservation, NaN Immunity, Anti-Tunneling CCD, Pass@10) (w4 = 20%)
AST/source cross-validation against hallucinations, false-positive pruning, global Snorm consolidation, and Final Report generation (w5 = 20%)
